mapper.insert: insert into mall_order(order_no, member_id, address_snapshot, total_amount, status, remark, payment_method, payment_status, order_source, points_used, create_time) values(#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{paymentMethod}, 'UNPAID', #{orderSource}, #{pointsUsed}, #{createTime})
